beats.text: This pull request changes who can open billing.
Every billing request goes through one check, called require admin.
This pull request rewrites that check.
Here is how the check answered before.
A member is blocked. An admin passes. So does a superadmin. An admin from another tenant is blocked.
Now the same four requests go through the new code.
The first three get the same answer.
The admin from another tenant now passes, and reads another company's billing.
One thing to check. Admins now return early, before the tenant comparison runs.
